reason: I'd probably start the free 14-day trial since there's no auto-billing, but I wouldn't pay yet. The app is grading itself with a phone on my nightstand, and with my bedtime moving every week, 7 nights per method feels too noisy to trust, so on $28k I'd just stay on the free version and my YouTube sleep sounds.
objection: The 'proof' comes from the same app that wants my money, measured by a phone guessing when I fell asleep from when I put it down. That's not evidence, that's marketing with a chart. I also haven't seen any app-store ratings or outside reviews.
would_change_my_mind: If my own 14-day comparison showed a clear gap, like falling asleep 10+ minutes faster on the SLEEP:ON nights, and the app had solid app-store ratings from real users, I'd take the yearly plan.
